question: Who among the following is the author of the book 'The Buddha and his Dhamma', which appeared in 1957 after the death of its author?
solution:
The correct answer is __**BR Ambedkar.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The author of the book **'The Buddha and his Dhamma'** is **B.R. Ambedkar.**
 
• The book was published **posthumously in 1957,** after the death of Ambedkar.
 
• The book is based on the** life and teachings of Buddha** and his philosophy of **Dhamma.**
 
• The book is an attempt to make the **teachings of Buddha accessible **to the masses and to explain the **relevance of Buddhism **in modern times.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Subhas Chandra Bose** was a **freedom fighter **and** politician** who played a significant role in India's struggle for independence.

 
 
• He was** not** the author of 'The Buddha and his Dhamma.'
 
 
 
• **Mahatma Gandhi** was a** political and spiritual leader** who led India to independence.
 
 
• While he was a proponent of **nonviolence and religious tolerance**, he was **not** the author of 'The Buddha and his Dhamma.'
 
 
 
• **Motilal Nehru **was a **lawyer and politician **who played an important role in the Indian National Congress.
 
 
• He was** not **the author of 'The Buddha and his Dhamma.'
 
 
 
• Hence, the** correct **answer is option 2.
